text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Creek, you don't look so good...

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I didn't mean to make you worry. I'm
fine. It's
nothing, really.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I just feel like I've been getting tired
more easily
lately...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's not your fault though! I've
probably just
been pushing myself a tad
too hard.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Although Супер Крик is smiling,
something is
very clearly wrong. I should
make some
adjustments to her race
schedule.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
